property_summary: For any non-empty recipient array, C.transfer invokes the callee's transferFrom(address,address,uint256) ABI entry exactly once per recipient (the recorder will have recorded that many transferFrom calls); the mutant using the wrong selector can fail to invoke transferFrom and so the recorded transferFrom call count can be less than the recipients length for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the selector constant to call transferFrom(address,address,uint256) with a different signature (amount typed as uint256 already — here we switch to transfer(address,uint256) which yields a different selector), causing the external calls to invoke a different function on caddress and potentially change success/failure and thus the returned outcome.
